name: gastrostomy tube
description: Radiopaque or radiolucent tube providing enteric access through the abdominal wall into the stomach, described by presence, type, position, stoma condition, and related complications.

attributes.name: presence
attributes.description: Whether a gastrostomy tube is visualized on imaging.

values.name: present
values.description: Gastrostomy tube is seen.

values.name: absent
values.description: No gastrostomy tube identified.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Temporal or clinical status of the gastrostomy tube compared with prior exams or clinical note.

values.name: new
values.description: Recently placed since prior imaging or first visualization.

values.name: unchanged
values.description: No interval change compared with prior imaging.

values.name: complication
values.description: Device-related complication suspected (see complication descriptors).

values.name: removed
values.description: Tube has been removed or is no longer present.

attributes.name: type of gastrostomy
attributes.description: Technique used to place the gastrostomy tube.

values.name: percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy
values.description: PEG tube placed endoscopically.

values.name: radiologic gastrostomy
values.description: Placed under radiologic guidance (fluoroscopy/CT).

values.name: surgical gastrostomy
values.description: Placed at surgery (open or laparoscopic).

attributes.name: retention balloon location
attributes.description: Location of the internal retention mechanism if present.

values.name: intraluminal stomach
values.description: Retention balloon lies within the stomach lumen.

values.name: extraluminal
values.description: Retention balloon or internal bumper is outside the gastric lumen (extra-gastric).

values.name: intraluminal bowel
values.description: Retention device projects into or through adjacent bowel lumen.

attributes.name: tube position
attributes.description: Assessment of the distal tube location relative to expected gastric position.

values.name: adequate
values.description: Tip and tube course are appropriate within the stomach.

values.name: malpositioned
values.description: Tube tip or course is not within the expected gastric position (migration or misplacement).

attributes.name: stoma condition
attributes.description: Appearance of the cutaneous stoma and peristomal soft tissues.

values.name: normal
values.description: No surrounding inflammation or soft tissue abnormality.

values.name: inflamed
values.description: Peristomal soft tissue thickening or stranding suggesting inflammation.

values.name: infected
values.description: Findings suggesting infection such as fluid collection, gas, or pronounced inflammatory change.

attributes.name: peritubal leakage
attributes.description: Evidence of fluid or contrast tracking around the tube/stoma.

values.name: present
values.description: Leakage or tracking of fluid/contrast around the tube.

values.name: absent
values.description: No peritubal leakage identified.

attributes.name: gastric distention
attributes.description: Degree of gastric luminal distention that may relate to tube function.

values.name: present
values.description: Gastric distention is present.

values.name: absent
values.description: No gastric distention identified.
